findings.detail: In portrait the editor is 480 px wide (`--robo-editor-width: clamp(480px, 58vw, 900px)`), so the scripts area is 407 px; the starter's "wait until … sees something closer than 3 studs" block is 84 px at the start scale 0.78. The 3 the goal line names starts at x 502, past the editor's right edge (under the stage). A student has to know to drag the scripts sideways to find it.

The wall runs off the stage's right edge (to x 933 on an 820 px screen). Recomputed in the page, framePoseInFreeArea plans a camera 93.3 units away so the rover and the wall fit the 340×756 px free area (their box at x 502–798), but the real camera draws that box at x 544–977: 1.46× the planned size. The studio's orbit camera caps its distance at max(64, 2 × the build's frame distance) (getBuildCameraLimits via BrickStudioScene's OrbitControls maxDistance), so a pose further away than that is pulled in.

In a 340 px stage the reading chips reflow while running: the Motors chip widens ("40 · 40 %", "speed 33 · 35 %") and Speed drops to a second row, so the readings grow from 94 to 155 px over the stage (and shrink back on Reset).

WebDriver typing into the focused prompt fired key events but inserted no text (still "3"); the 6 was entered with a script-dispatched input event, then OK was tapped. The software keyboard was not exercised (the simulator has a hardware keyboard connected).
